title: Trigger Awareness (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to identify emotional triggers that affect their behaviour toward partners and children, and to develop safe responses.
learningOutcomes: Understand how triggers affect children’s sense of safety.
Recognise escalation patterns in parenting contexts.
Develop safe strategies for managing triggers.

modules.title: Triggers in Fathering
modules.content: Explores how parenting stress activates emotional responses.

modules.title: Impact on Children and Partner
modules.content: Shows how triggered behaviour creates fear or instability.

modules.title: Safe Trigger Management
modules.content: Provides tools for grounding, pausing, and safe behaviour.
